_readme: ADVERSARIAL SEED for the WarrantyClaims group. TEMPORARY - deleted in Step 08.
THIS IS THE HIGHEST-RISK GROUP IN THE MIGRATION, and the row below is the reason.
THE TRAP 3-READ, confirmed on both sides and adversarially re-verified:
ADP.WarrantyClaims.Data/AutoMapperProfiles/Financial.cs:44-48 maps
WarrantyClaim -> DealerFinancialListDTO and ends with five .Ignore() calls:
.ForMember(x => x.DistComment1,                 x => x.Ignore())
.ForMember(x => x.HourTotalDistributor,         x => x.Ignore())
.ForMember(x => x.LaborTotalAmountDistributor,  x => x.Ignore())
.ForMember(x => x.SubletTotalAmountDistributor, x => x.Ignore())
.ForMember(x => x.PartsTotalAmountDistributor,  x => x.Ignore())
Those five members are DELIBERATELY BLANKED on the dealer-facing view. If the generated
convention mapper matches them by name - which is exactly what a convention mapper does -
the dealer view starts returning distributor financials.
THE SEED IS WHAT MAKES THIS VISIBLE. If the five ENTITY columns are null, the dealer DTO
shows null whether the mapper ignores them or copies them, and the regression is invisible.
Claim 8000001 therefore carries NON-NULL values in all five - distinctive ones, so a diff
reads unmistakably.
AND IT SHOWS ON THE ORDINARY FULL-ACCESS PASS. DealerFinancialController is a SEPARATE route
with its own DTO, not a privilege-filtered projection: its only gate is a three-way conjunct
that a full-access principal passes, and which does not run at all when the action is null
(which it is here - this group declares no action tree and takes consumer-supplied actions,
all left null). DealerFinancialRepository is bare base(db) with no row scoping. So
GET /DealerFinancial returns the five members NULL in this baseline and POPULATED if the
trap fires. Do not wait for the restricted pass to catch it.
ID BLOCKS, chosen so no row's PK equals a foreign id it carries:
WarrantyClaim               8_000_00x
Certificate                 8_010_00x  (dbo - owned by ADP.Cases, shared with ClaimableItems)
ManufacturerSettlmentSheet  8_020_00x
AdditionalLaborOperationCode 8_030_00x
WarrantyClaimLaborLine      8_040_00x  <- child rows
TABLE ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING. Keys beginning with _ are harness metadata, never written to SQL.
CompanyID = 1 ON EVERY SCOPED ROW. The framework's default data-level filters compare a
row's CompanyID against IdentityClaimProvider.GetCompanyID(), which resolves to 1 for the
parity principal (verified in-request). A row with a different or NULL CompanyID is
silently excluded - the list returns {"Count":0,"Value":[]} with a 200, so the baseline
looks healthy and proves nothing. The hostile-row gate is what catches that.
WHICH scoping columns matter is decided by the INTERFACES the entity implements, not by
which columns happen to exist. WarrantyClaim is IEntityHasCompany AND
IEntityHasCompanyBranch (WarrantyClaim.cs:19-22), so BOTH filters apply and setting only
CompanyID still yields an empty list. Check the entity's interface list before seeding.
THE SHARED Certificate ENTITY IS DISCRIMINATED BY CertificateType (SPIKE-8 territory):
0 = WarrantyClaim (this group), 1 = ClaimableItemClaim (the other). Seeding the wrong
value yields an empty list with a 200 - the same silent shape as a scoping mismatch.

rows._why: THE TRAP 3-READ ROW. All five distributor-side members are NON-NULL. GET /DealerFinancial must show them as null; GET /DistributorFinancial may show them populated. A dealer response carrying these values is the regression.
CONTROL row with the five distributor members NULL. If a diff appears on BOTH rows the cause is global; if only on 8000001, it is the ignored-member mapping specifically.
Soft-deleted. Must never appear in a list body. No _marker - its ABSENCE is the assertion.
Live labour line on claim 8000001. PK 8040001 differs from WarrantyClaimID 8000001 on purpose - a child collection must carry its OWN id, not the parent's.
SOFT-DELETED labour line on the SAME claim. Any child collection over labour lines must exclude it.

The SHARED ADP.Cases Certificate entity. CertificateType MUST be 0 (CertificateTypes.WarrantyClaim) - WarrantyCertificateRepository filters CertificateType == WarrantyClaim, and 1 is ClaimableItemClaim, the OTHER group's discriminator. InvoiceDate is set because WarrantyInvoice additionally filters InvoiceDate.HasValue. CertificateNo and DisplayDistributorCertificateNo are insert-only sequence columns the reverse map must not write.

Plain row so this triple's list body is non-empty. Carries NO _marker: the list DTO exposes only ID / InvoiceNumbers / IsDeleted, so there is no string column a marker could live in and be matched literally.
Plain row so this triple's list body is non-empty. An empty list is a case that cannot fail.
